name: smithers
title: Smithers
summary: The essential targets of this repository: the whole CI graph, build and check, tests, lint, docs, and the LLM code-review lints.

entries.title: Run everything
entries.summary: Build, check, test, lint and docs over every package: the CI job's own step (smithers-build ci '//packages/...').

entries.label: //:ci
entries.title: CI workflow file
entries.summary: Regenerate and drift-check .github/workflows/ci.yml, the pipeline definition (not the run itself).

entries.title: Build every package
entries.summary: Build targets over every package (smithers-build build '//packages/...').

entries.label: //:tsconfig
entries.title: Root tsconfig
entries.summary: Regenerate and check the workspace tsconfig.json from PACKAGE.ts.

entries.label: //:knownFiles
entries.title: known-files.d.ts
entries.summary: Regenerate the known-files declaration from the target graph.

entries.label: //packages/flows:check
entries.title: Typecheck @smthrs/flows
entries.summary: tsc over the aggregate barrel and everything it re-exports.

entries.label: //packages/flows:lib
entries.title: Build @smthrs/flows
entries.summary: Emit the aggregate barrel's dist.

entries.label: //packages/cli:check
entries.title: Typecheck the smithers CLI
entries.summary: tsc over packages/cli.

entries.title: Test every package
entries.summary: Test targets over every package (smithers-build test '//packages/...').

entries.label: //packages/flows:test
entries.title: Test @smthrs/flows
entries.summary: The aggregate barrel's vitest suite, coverage gates enforced.

entries.label: //packages/cli:test
entries.title: Test the smithers CLI
entries.summary: packages/cli vitest suite.

entries.label: //scripts:browserContract
entries.title: Browser bundle contract
entries.summary: The browser bundle builds and exposes the contract surface.

entries.label: //scripts:effectVersion
entries.title: Single effect version
entries.summary: Exactly one effect version resolves across every manifest and both lockfiles.

entries.label: //scripts:dependencyBoundaries
entries.title: Dependency boundaries
entries.summary: No package imports cross declared workspace boundaries.

entries.title: Lint every package
entries.summary: Lint targets over every package (smithers-build lint '//packages/...').

entries.label: //packages/flows:lint
entries.title: ESLint @smthrs/flows
entries.summary: eslint --max-warnings=0 over the aggregate barrel.

entries.label: //packages/flows:fmt
entries.title: dprint check @smthrs/flows
entries.summary: Formatting check; every package declares its own lint and fmt targets.

entries.label: //scripts:docs
entries.title: Docs check
entries.summary: The documentation site's pages and generator agree with the tree.

entries.label: //scripts:llms
entries.title: llms.txt bundles
entries.summary: docs/llms-full.txt and friends are regenerated and in sync.

entries.label: //lint:durableIdentityGuard
entries.title: Review: durable identity
entries.summary: A cheap Codex review of the diff against origin/main for identity strings, migrations, persisted schemas and durable keys.

entries.label: //lint:docsReferenceSync
entries.title: Review: docs reference sync
entries.summary: A cheap Codex review of changed public APIs against the hand-written reference and concept pages.

entries.label: //lint:jsdocTruthfulness
entries.title: Review: JSDoc truthfulness
entries.summary: A cheap Codex review of changed exports against their JSDoc.
